main_text.p: naventuram, aliosve eius fermenti: nam an-te Lumbardi sæcula nemo sanctorum sic do-cuit. Porro hanc conclusionem, non tanquam cœlestem doctrinam, sed ut opinio-nem probabiliorem eligendam statuunt. Novo plane & peregrino instituto. Nam quum de fide Catholica tractat Ecclesia Christi, non solet fluctuando ad probabiliores opi-niones, nescio quas, dubitanter accedere: sed certam veritatem è scripturis definitam tradere. Viennense hoc Concilium celebratum est sub Clemente quinto, Anno Christi 1311.

Ex hoc fonte manarunt Scholasticorum subsequentium disputationes, de habitu infuso, & virtute inhærente: de opere operato in sacramentis de merito congrui extra sacramenta. li.2.dist.27.Itaq; Iohannes Scotus sic docet: {a}Gratia formaliter est virtus quæ est charitas. Hæc ex Aquinate: quædam ipse adiecit, quæ doctrinam meriti de congruo fœculentam Tridentinis pararunt. Sic enim docet: lib.4.dist.14 qu[?] a.{b}peccator potest ex naturalibus, cum communi influentia considerare peccatum commissum, ut offensivum Dei. Potest voluntas peccatum sic consideratum detestari, & ille motus potest continuari, & intendi ante infusionem gratiæ: ille autem motus dicitur attritio. Et est dispositio, siue meritum de congruo. Si manet idem motus contra peccatum in esse naturæ & mori[?], qui prius fuit attritio, in illo stante fit contritio. Hæc doctrina à Scoto vel inventa, vel sedulo retenta est. Scotus ergo meritum congrui sic describi-tur, ut in-

page.notes: Left page: "ut in-" at the foot of the column is printed as "vtin-", so the paragraph continues beyond the visible text; the hyphen is printed. Doubtful readings: "mori[?]" in the Scotus passage, where the print is smudged; "qu[?]" in the note "lib.4.dist.14 gu a." The reference marks a and b are shown in braces in the text, with their margin notes. The heavy show-through and blotches in the centre of the page obscure parts of lines, but the lines are readable. Right page: only the cut-off left-hand edge of the text is visible, so each line is a fragment; the fragments are copied as far as the scan shows them, and the words are not reliable. No running head, page number or catchword is visible on the right page.
